# WJ44 · Kho tri thức · nguồn hỏng và đang xử lý

Group **WJ · Quản trị agent (Next.js)** · state · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/admin/kb`) · account `owner`

## Purpose
State of [WJ40](WJ40.md) · Kho tri thức: nguồn hỏng và đang xử lý. Page: Knowledge base: documents are cut into passages that the assistant searches with its `kb_search` tool. Upload files or type text, assign sources to agents, let a doctor approve, test a search, tag guide articles.

## Agent and care context
- A source is read by an agent only after it is assigned to that agent (default: none) and, for patient-facing use, approved by a doctor ("Chưa duyệt" is amber). Staff read the same sources in the Guide (`/guide`) when a source carries a guide tag.

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `owner` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `kb.read` to open (owner, manager, doctor, cs_staff, reception); `kb.manage` for the approval switch and guide tags (owner, manager).
- Roles that can open the page: All five staff roles read; owner and manager manage; doctor sees WJ45 (no manage rights).
- Menu entry: "Kho tri thức" in the section "Quản trị agent", shown when the role holds any of `kb.read`.

## Key actions
- (actions of the page; this state or dialog adds the controls its Layout lists)
- "Thêm nguồn" (upload a file, or type text)
- "Thử tìm", "Hướng dẫn"
- Row: "Xử lý lại", "Nhãn hướng dẫn", "Xem đoạn", "Xóa"
- Switch "Bác sĩ duyệt" (kb.manage); the agent cell shows which agents read the source

## Business rules
- Patient safety is a policy profile, never a removed feature: `patient_channel` (the default: messages to patients go to the review queue and a person sends them; memory from patient content is off; image, video, document and web tools are off; a red flag goes to a doctor before any model call; personal data is masked before the model; identity of a Zalo user is confirmed before the assistant names a patient) and `staff_assistant` (internal, staff-only accounts). The profile is set per Zalo account and per agent, the stricter of the two applies (PLAN-AI01 section 5).
